ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The fragment on the left side of the figure is shown as R–C≡C–Br, where R is connected to the alkynyl carbon, the two carbons are drawn as a triple bond between them, and the right-end carbon is connected to Br. There is also an independent Bu⁻ fragment at the lower right. There are curved arrows in the figure, but the problem asks to ignore arrows. Reasoning: According to the specified method, count each single-bond, double-bond, and triple-bond connection between non-hydrogen atoms as one bond connection. In the left R–C≡C–Br fragment, R–C is 1 bond, C≡C is 1 triple-bond connection, and C–Br is 1 bond, for a total of 3. Bu represents butyl, whose heavy-atom skeleton is C–C–C–C and contains 3 C–C bonds. Add all components: 3 + 3 = 6.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the left fragment as R–C≡C–Br and the separate nucleophile as Bu⁻, with curved arrows present but excluded. Count non-hydrogen bonds in the left fragment: R–C is 1, C≡C is 1 triple-bond connection, and C–Br is 1, giving 3. Expand Bu as a butyl group and count its heavy-atom skeleton: C–C–C–C has 3 C–C bonds. Add 3 + 3 = 6.

推理：按指定方法把每个非氢原子之间的单键、双键、三键连接各计为一个键连接。左侧 R–C≡C–Br 片段中，R–C 为 1 个键，C≡C 为 1 个三键连接，C–Br 为 1 个键，共 3 个。Bu 表示丁基，其重原子骨架为 C–C–C–C，包含 3 个 C–C 键。将所有组件相加：3 + 3 = 6。
